package main

import (
	"example.com/hangar/internal/fps"
	"runtime"
)

var stats runtime.MemStats
var walker fps.Walker
var control []byte

func main() {}

//go:wasmexport tick
func tick(mode uint32, frame uint64) float32 {
	if mode != 1 {
		fps.SetFloorZ("acid-control-west-lift#0", fps.ElevatorFloor(frame))
	}
	if mode == 0 {
		return fps.ElevatorFloor(frame)
	}
	walker.Reset()
	return walker.StepUp(6, 9.68, 1.7, 6, 9.735)
}

//go:wasmexport allocations
func allocations() uint64 { runtime.ReadMemStats(&stats); return stats.Mallocs }

//go:wasmexport allocated_bytes
func allocatedBytes() uint64 { runtime.ReadMemStats(&stats); return stats.TotalAlloc }

//go:wasmexport negative_control
func negativeControl() { control = make([]byte, 2048); control[0] = 1 }
